Implementation plan (complexity: high; cross-provider trusted execution and exact-CAS publication):
1. Wait for knots-ccdc, knots-c472, knots-74e2, and knots-9b6a to be SHIPPED. Pin their exact main commits and treat their integrator, signed-submission, GitHub ruleset, and Diffinite receive-policy interfaces as authoritative. Do not begin code or live mutation while any dependency is unfinished.
2. Define a provider-neutral trusted-run contract in Knots around sealed provider evidence. Inputs bind stable repository identity, authenticated policy revision/digest, trusted runner identity, protected inbox registry/ref names, exact starting inbox/control/canonical/archive OIDs, and freshness evidence. Only validated GitHub and Diffinite adapters may construct the capability that invokes integration; tracked files, remote URLs, workflow inputs, and inbox bytes cannot self-attest authority.
3. Add a data-only integration entrypoint around the shipped knots-ccdc integrator. Fetch registered protected inbox commits/trees/blobs by exact provider-returned OID, parse only allowlisted protocol-v2 bundle paths, and pass bytes to validation without checkout, hooks, submodules, actions, scripts, build steps, or executable permissions. Reject path escape, symlink/gitlink, unexpected object type, oversized input, schema/hash/signature/sequence mismatch, and registry/OID drift.
4. Implement the GitHub trusted-run adapter as a default-branch Actions workflow plus a minimal CLI/library entrypoint. Read back the applicable repository rulesets, Actions integration identity, protected ref registry, and exact ref OIDs through authenticated APIs. Fail closed if role bypasses exist, the expected integration is absent, pagination is incomplete, policy revision changes, or any ref moves during the read. Use only the trusted workflow identity to publish.
5. Implement the Diffinite adapter using its authenticated service runner and receive-policy facts. Bind authorization to the service capability and DIFFINITE_CREDENTIAL_ID, verify the installed policy digest/rollback floor and protected-ref registry, fetch exact OIDs through the supported service transport, and fail closed on actor-ID substitution, permissive hook state, stale policy, or ref drift. Never use a human session as authority.
6. Invoke knots-ccdc with the winning control record and the complete registered writer set. Produce projection-complete deterministic snapshots, lossless compressed packs, exact event-ID/content-hash index, writer vector, and durable conflict ledger. Independently full-replay predecessor plus accepted tails and require byte-equivalence for hot, warm, cold, edge, lease, workflow, metadata, quarantine, writer, and conflict projections before publication.
7. Publish immutable pack/index/snapshot/conflict-ledger/generation objects and additive archive refs first. Verify provider readback of every exact OID. Attempt control advancement exactly once with expected-old OID last. On CAS loss, discard no object or inbox data: reload the winning control and registry, refetch new tails, rebuild, and retry from new immutable objects. Never force-update or rewind control.
8. Implement recovery as a new epoch strictly greater than the active epoch and with a writer vector dominating every acknowledged writer head. Verify recovery by full replay and exact provider readback before its final control CAS. Preserve stale/conflicting inputs in the durable conflict ledger and retained inbox refs.
9. Add deterministic fixtures shared by both adapters for hostile inbox trees, policy/OID races, incomplete registries, concurrent writers, duplicate/mutated events, stale CAS, runner identity substitution, and recovery dominance. Assert authoritative refs and SQLite remain unchanged on every failure and all objects remain retained.
10. Add disposable live GitHub and Diffinite canaries using the already approved rails. For each provider, prove an ordinary credential is rejected, the trusted runner consumes data without executing it, immutable refs appear before control, exact OIDs match readback, one concurrent CAS wins, the loser rebuilds, and a fresh replay is byte-equivalent. Use disposable refs/repositories only and delete nothing.
11. Run focused compaction/provider tests, cargo fmt/check/test, size and coverage gates, and make sanity. Commit imperatively, attach sneka-agents notes, publish through the repository rail, verify exact main, and then advance through review/shipment under fresh e2e leases.

Ownership: this Knot owns trusted execution adapters and orchestration from protected inboxes through ccdc publication. It does not reimplement signing, provider receive/ruleset enforcement, the ccdc integration algorithm, client fetch/application, legacy bridge cutover, retention deletion, production PostgreSQL, or new infrastructure. No later operator approval gate exists inside this approved scope. Dependencies: knots-d6dd is blocked by knots-ccdc, knots-c472, knots-74e2, and knots-9b6a; knots-4521 is blocked by knots-d6dd; knots-d6e4 remains downstream through knots-4521.
